title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning for queueing fairness, starvation prevention, and timeouts
author: Daniel Park
release_notes: Improves continuous-batcher scheduling to reduce starvation and improve fairness across traffic classes; adds timeouts to queued requests and new observability metrics for batch wait time and preemptions.
description: Motivation: in high-concurrency tail workloads we observed starvation of low-priority/long-tail requests due to aggressive batching of high-priority short requests. This PR tunes the continuous-batcher scheduler to improve fairness and avoid starvation while preserving throughput. Changes include: 1) a hybrid queueing strategy that keeps a short headroom queue per priority class so short requests can form small batches without indefinitely delaying long requests; 2) a starvation prevention loop that preempts a fraction of slots for oldest-waiting requests when per-class wait percentiles exceed configured thresholds; 3) configurable per-request timeouts and a conservative backoff for requeue attempts to avoid hot loops; 4) weight-aware batch formation that factors request age and class weight into batch candidate scoring; 5) new metrics and traces to make batch wait times, preemption events and requeue counts visible; 6) updated defaults that are conservative for existing deployments but can be tuned via continuous-batcher config. Testing and validation: unit tests added for queue ordering and preemption behavior; integration test that replays a synthetic traffic mix (70% short-high-priority, 30% long-low-priority) and asserts p95 wait-time improvements for low-priority class; small-scale perf bench showing <2% throughput regression and 40-60% reduction in low-priority p95 latency under stressed mixes. Rollout plan: feature gated behind continuous_batcher.scheduler.v2 flag; default enabled in canary pools for 72h and monitored via newly introduced metrics. See linked Linear tickets ENG-4321 (scheduler fairness) and ENG-4398 (starvation incident follow-up).
commits: feat(batcher): add per-priority headroom queues and queueing strategy (Park)
fix(batcher): avoid hot requeue loops by adding exponential backoff for requeued requests (Park)
perf(batcher): implement age-weighted batch scorer for fairness (Park)
test(batcher): add unit and integration tests for preemption and timeout behavior (Park)
docs: document scheduler tuning knobs and rollout guidance (Park)
changed_snippets: scheduler.py: added preempt_oldest_if_starving(timeout_ms, fraction) and headroom queue logic; main loop now computes score = base_score + age_weight * age_ms; preemption hook guarded by config flag
queue.py: moved requeue backoff to RequeueBackoff class, default base=5ms, multiplier=1.8, max=200ms; requeue attempts now capped per-request
age_weighted_scorer.py: new module implementing weighted scoring used by batch formation; tests simulate age vs size tradeoffs
review_comments: Aisha Patel: Please add a short note on how this interacts with KV cache warmup - could preemptions increase cache misses for long-running generation?
Daniel Park (author): Good point; added a comment and a conservative default that avoids preempting in the first request_of_session window to reduce KV cache churn
Marcus Liu: The requeue backoff makes sense but please ensure we don't add unbounded queuing memory; can we add an enforcement policy?
Daniel Park: Added queue length caps and a soft-drop path when queue cap exceeded; documented behavior and added tests
Sara Gomez: Metrics look useful; please add labels for model and pool so we can slice by workload in Grafana
Daniel Park: Updated batcher_metrics.go to include model_id and pool_id labels for relevant metrics; added dashboard JSON in docs
discussion_summary: Reviewers requested changes around KV cache interaction, queue memory caps, and metric labels; author addressed all requests and tests were added. CI initially failed on a flaky integration test which was fixed by stabilizing the synthetic traffic generator's timing and adding guardrails for timing windows.
notes_on_rollout: Feature gated under continuous_batcher.scheduler.v2; canary rollout for 72h with alerting on batch_wait_p95 regressions and starvation_preemptions; default conservative knobs recommended for global pools. Ops playbook updated in docs/continuous-batcher.md.
post_merge_tasks: Monitor batch_wait_p95 and starvation_preemptions in canary pools for 72h
If stable, flip feature flag in dedicated pools on next maintenance window
Follow up ticket ENG-4444 to expose per-customer knobs in Dedicated
benchmarks_summary: Synthetic 70/30 mix: low-priority p95 wait reduced by 40-60% depending on arrival pattern; overall throughput regression <2%; benchmark scripts added under benchmarks/batcher_fairness.
notes_for_changelog: Improve continuous-batcher fairness and starvation prevention; new metrics: batch_wait_p50/p95, starvation_preemptions, requeue_count; new config knobs documented.
